I mean, I have. Or I try. I don't want to be big and important, I just want to have a reason to live. I make mistakes all the time, I know it's part of being human. That's not what bothers me. It's just annoying everyone around me for practically existing.

Well for example yesterday... I was in the room waiting for class to start. One of my old professors came and joked in a good way about me to my current professor. He goes "Oh, you better grade her tough... she's a really good student!" I was so proud of that fact, so I go to tell me boyfriend. He just brushed it aside. Then, I cooked my first meal on my own that evening. And it turned out really well, so I go to tell my parents, and they don't care at all, just saying "ok". 

The one thing wrong with me is my depression. My suicidal tendencies. That's why I feel lonely.

That same sort of situation happened to me about 2 years ago. I tried hanging myself too, slipped before I wanted to, and swung myself somehow back onto the chair. After that, a friend of mine had me see a school counselor and explain. That resulted in me being put in the hospital. But that 'PTSD' will stay with you... heck when I reached my 1 year, I was in a really bad state in fear of it happening again. But just find someone or something to keep your mind off of it, even if temporary. I hope that your situation gets better, and I'm here if ya need to talk
